Chapter 1030: 1: A Simple Retreat (Asking For Monthly Votes)_2

Chapter 1030: Chapter 1: A Simple Retreat (Asking for Monthly Votes)_2

Actually, the difficulty of reaching the ultimate evolution and crossing into the Twelfth Tier in the Chaos Void is lower than crossing into the Twelfth Tier within the universe.

The time river of the Chaos Void has little backlash against life forms attempting ultimate evolution, greatly increasing the likelihood of success.

This is precisely the reason.

The nine supreme beings of human civilization have considered this possibility.

So far, human civilization’s existing Twelfth-Tier evolutionary path is singular, but cultivating along this path is extremely troublesome. More Twelfth-Tier evolutionary paths need to be developed.

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded, keeping this matter close to heart.

“When the time comes, you, Galaxy, will help us purchase the necessary items. The expenses will come out of the Human Civilization Treasury.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme said.

As for why they did not purchase the items themselves?

The nine supreme beings of human civilization are far less discerning and insightful than Lin Yuan, unable to properly evaluate the strengths and drawbacks of a true Twelfth-Tier evolutionary path.

Thus, they entrusted Lin Yuan with this task.

Rather than risk choosing wrongly themselves and regretting it, it’s better to leave the judgment and decisions to Lin Yuan.

“This is not urgent; you can do it whenever you deem fit, Galaxy.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme said in a relaxed tone.

Even in the Chaos Void, matters concerning ultimate evolution carry great importance—waiting thousands or tens of thousands of years is entirely normal.

…

At the deepest point of the ‘Fragment World of Star Tears,’ Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

This ‘Fragment World’ was first purchased as Lin Yuan’s private cultivation abode; only secondarily did it become the new home for human civilization. Naturally, Lin Yuan held the highest level of authority here.

“Martial Arts Evolution Road…”

Lin Yuan examined himself, as well as the path he had traversed in the past.

So far, the Martial Tao Evolution Road had been developed up to the Twelfth-Tier “Opening the Path” chapter. As for the “Domination Chapter”? It was still being refined and had not yet been fully established.

However, this time Lin Yuan went into solitary cultivation not to continue perfecting the Domination Chapter but to attempt an expansion of the ‘breadth’ of the Martial Arts Evolution Road.

Precisely speaking, it was to establish several branching paths for the Martial Arts Evolution Road.

Each of these branches would independently constitute a Twelfth-Tier path, yet all would take Martial Tao as the foundation and extend into distinct directions.

“The Great Dao is endless; even the same Dao is not fixed—it can diverge into numerous branches, all leading to the same destination.”

Lin Yuan contemplated inwardly, with reflections upon Martial Tao constantly emerging in his mind.

Establishing new branches for Martial Tao was an idea Lin Yuan had conceived ever since crossing into the Twelfth Tier.

It was just that he had never had the time to actualize it.

Under the pressures of universal catastrophe, everything Lin Yuan had focused on over the past centuries was directed at the most immediate ways of enhancing his own foundation and combat strength.

As for branching Martial Tao? It had no immediate effect on his Martial Tao cultivation or on himself.

Thus, it hadn’t been on Lin Yuan’s priority list of must-do tasks.

Now that a new home for human civilization had been found and all matters were proceeding systematically,

Lin Yuan was able to rest briefly and begin considering this matter.

Branching the Martial Tao road may indeed have little short-term impact,

But over a longer timeline, its significance would become immense and simply impossible to overlook.

Even crossing into the Twelfth Tier via different branches, the essence would still be rooted in the Martial Tao Evolution Road,

Allowing Lin Yuan to reap the myriad benefits that arise from establishing branching paths and creating more Twelfth-Tier beings.

During ultimate evolution, countless cultivators of Martial Tao Evolution Road called out to Lin Yuan from the depths of the void, ensuring his spiritual will did not collapse,

Ultimately enabling him to easily pass through the Heart Demon World borne from the primary tributary of the time river.

And this ‘anchor point’ effect is certainly not confined to ultimate evolution.

Perhaps one day, when Lin Yuan’s true form, avatars, and manifestations have all perished—even when his consciousness in the source world has fallen.

If his spirit sinks into boundless darkness and remains trapped within death, these calls will still reverberate.

Helping Lin Yuan lock onto ‘anchor points’ and forcefully return.

The wider-reaching cultivation of Martial Tao Evolution Road by living beings, and the greater number of strong practitioners arising from it, will only amplify these calls, rendering them irresistible—even transcending space and time itself.

“In fact, the Martial Tao I established has long laid the groundwork for numerous branching paths…”

Lin Yuan meditated cross-legged, flashes of inspiration continually bursting in his mind.

Starting from the Second Layer of Martial Tao, differentiation within Martial Tao had already begun.

Lin Yuan used Yin-Yang Taiji as the core of his own Martial Tao foundation,

While other Martial Tao cultivators might choose entirely different cores for their Martial Tao foundation.

For instance, Martial Arts Evolutionaries adept at the Power of Gold could readily use Golden Power as the basis of their Martial Tao foundation,

By the time they reach the Fifth Layer, evolving Golden Power into the Golden Primordial Spirit, which would ultimately grant insight into the Golden Rules.

And so on—starting from the Second Layer of Martial Tao, it encompassed all things, with countless paths accessible within the Martial Tao Cultivation System.

…

From the Second to Eleventh Layer of Martial Tao, Martial Arts Evolutionaries had long chosen specialties, following the paths Lin Yuan had carved forward.

“I created the Twelfth-Tier Martial Tao based on Taiji Yin and Yang as its root, but other Martial Tao cultivators can absolutely base their pathways on their own choices to achieve their Twelfth Tier.”

Lin Yuan’s eyes shone brightly with vigor.

In this way, the potential of Martial Tao would grow to unprecedented levels, theoretically allowing it to branch indefinitely and give rise to countless Martial Tao Twelfth-Tier practitioners.

“First, I will establish the simplest Martial Tao Five Elements branches…” Lin Yuan began to delve into deeper insights.

The first would be the branch of gold—gold signifies sharpness and cutting edge, shattering all barriers.

This Martial Tao branch, though somewhat extreme, was more than sufficient to ascend to the Twelfth Tier.

[Your unparalleled insight enables you to newly establish and perfect the Martial Tao Evolution Road, completing the Metal Martial Arts branch…]

…

[Your unparalleled insight enables you to newly establish and perfect the Martial Tao Evolution Road, completing the Wood Martial Arts branch…]
